title: Convolution as an average
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $f,g:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Their convolution at $x$ equals the uniform average over $y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ of $f(y)g(x-y)$.
